reason: The application tracker sounds useful for keeping follow-ups straight, but I would not install it until I know it runs acceptably on my laptop and how much setup it takes. I can keep using my spreadsheet while I check the requirements.
objection: Will running the app on my laptop use too much memory or take a lot of setup?
would_change_my_mind: A short, tested setup guide showing memory use and first-search time on ordinary laptops, plus a simple way to keep my spreadsheet data.
